channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Tehran Says It Is Reviewing U.S. Proposal as Trump Makes New Threats
item.description: Iran is reviewing a US proposal to end the war after President Trump threatened to resume strikes. An Iranian official said his government was looking at an American plan to end the war, hours after President Trump threatened to resume strikes.

item.title: Andorra owner Pique handed six-game ban for outburst at referee
item.description: Gerard Pique received a six-game ban for his outburst at a referee. Andorra owner Pique handed six-game ban for outburst at referee.

item.title: Iran’s Oil Sector and Economy Are Under Pressure as U.S. Blockade Bites
item.description: Iran's oil sector is under pressure due to a US blockade. Tehran says it can endure the pain, but its oil may soon have nowhere to go. Iran’s Oil Sector and Economy Are Under Pressure as U. S.

item.title: A Hotel in Venezuela’s Capital Has Become the U.S. Embassy’s De Facto Headquarters
item.description: The J. W. Marriott in Venezuela's capital is now the de facto US Embassy headquarters. Marriott in Venezuela’s capital is suddenly awash in U. S. diplomats, spies and fortune seekers, showcasing changes in the country.

item.title: Trump says bombing will resume if Iran doesn't agree to peace: Iran war updates
item.description: President Trump warned that bombing will resume if Iran does not agree to peace. Trump says bombing will resume if Iran doesn't agree to peace: Iran war updates USA Today.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran with ‘higher level’ bombing if it doesn't reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran has expressed interest in a "comprehensive agreement" with the US. The Strait of Hormuz has been virtually shut since February 28, blocking about 20% of world oil supplies. The strait has ‌been virtually shut since the conflict began on February 28 with air attacks on Iran ‌by ⁠the U. S.

item.title: Kyiv accuses Russia of violating ceasefire with fresh strikes
item.description: Ukraine's capital Kyiv accused Russia of violating a ceasefire with fresh strikes, escalating tensions in the conflict. The strikes targeted several areas, causing damage and casualties. Ukraine war live: Kyiv accuses Russia of violating ceasefire with fresh strikes The Independent.

item.title: Trump issues ultimatum for Iran to accept deal or face more bombing
item.description: US President Donald Trump issued an ultimatum to Iran, warning that if it does not accept a proposed deal, the US will resume bombing at a higher intensity. Trump's statement came as Iran considers the US proposal.

item.title: Trump pauses Hormuz operation; says war will end if Iran agrees to deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump paused the Hormuz operation, citing a need to finalize a deal with Iran. Trump said the war could end if Iran agrees to the proposed agreement.

item.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
item.description: Oil prices dropped and stock markets rose after reports of a potential deal to end the Iran war. The development raised hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran.

item.title: UN demands Israel immediately releases flotilla activists
item.description: The United Nations has called on Israel to immediately release two activists detained on a flotilla bound for Gaza. Israel has not commented on the UN's demand. The activists were detained on a ship attempting to reach Gaza.

item.title: Abdellatif Hammouchi Leads Security Delegation to Vienna for UN Meeting
item.description: Morocco's Abdellatif Hammouchi led a security delegation to Vienna for a UN meeting, marking a diplomatic effort by the North African country. Abdellatif Hammouchi Leads Security Delegation to Vienna for UN Meeting Morocco World News.

item.title: Iran is now a superpower; ties with India are flourishing: Iran Foreign Ministry spokesperson
item.description: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson, Mr. Baqaei, stated that Iran's ties with India are flourishing. He also mentioned that Tehran is reviewing America's response to its peace proposal. The proposal aims to improve relations between Iran and the US.

item.title: CNN founder Ted Turner, a brash and outspoken television pioneer, has died at age 87
item.description: Ted Turner, the founder of CNN and a television pioneer, has died at the age of 87. He transformed an Atlanta TV station into a satellite-based "superstation" and founded the first 24-hour news network, CNN. Turner was known for his outspoken personality.

item.title: Four killed in post-election violence in India’s West Bengal
item.description: Four people were killed in post-election violence in India's West Bengal, where the ruling BJP won the state election for the first time. The unrest has gripped the key eastern state, with reports of clashes between supporters and opponents.

item.title: Greetings from a sea village in Indonesia, where Indigenous fishing gets help from mangroves
item.description: The Indonesian village of Torosiaje is benefiting from mangroves to support Indigenous fishing. Colorful stilted houses in the village are perched over the Molucca Sea. As a water taxi rounded a corner at sunset, the village of Torosiaje came into view, with its colorful stilted houses perched over the Molucca Sea.

item.title: 'If They Don't Agree, Bombing Starts': Trump Threatens Iran Amid Deal Buzz
item.description: Trump threatened Iran with bombing if a deal is not agreed upon. The FBI has been carrying out a detailed examination of Allen's social media activity. 'If They Don't Agree, Bombing Starts': Trump Threatens Iran Amid Deal Buzz.

item.title: The Iran War Is Breaking NATO And Pushing U.S. Out Of Europe
item.description: The Iran war is straining NATO and US relations with Europe. The Iran War Is Breaking NATO And Pushing U. S. Out Of Europe – OpEd Eurasia Review.

item.title: Phosphorus Emerges as a Growing Global Security Concern
item.description: Phosphorus is becoming a global security concern due to scarcity. The Next Resource Crisis: Phosphorus Emerges as a Growing Global Security Concern NC State University.

item.title: What's behind Suu Kyi's transfer to house arrest?
item.description: Aung San Suu Kyi was transferred to house arrest from prison. The transfer of Aung San Suu Kyi from prison to house arrest has been welcomed cautiously abroad, but experts say Myanmar's military may be using it to boost legitimacy as the nation remains engulfed in civil war.
